title: The Fountains at Hidden Lake II
address:
10556 W. Ashburn Lane
Crystal River, Florida 34428
United States
description:
The Fountains at Hidden Lake II is a new multi-unit residential rental community for seniors in Crystal River, Florida, located along W. Ashburn Lane off US Highway 19. The four-story building will hold 67 one- and two-bedroom units, each with a private balcony, built as a wood-frame structure with engineered floor and roof trusses on a post-tensioned concrete slab foundation, and fully sprinklered to NFPA 13R standards.

The ground floor includes a mail area adjacent to the elevator lobby along with leasing and maintenance offices, with an elevator core, stair towers, and a trash room at one end of the building. The project also includes a detached porte cochere at the main entrance and a separate pool restroom pavilion.
